top_signal.title: ACCA student in Pakistan trying to get my first remote bookkeeping clients. How did you find yours?
top_signal.summary: Hey all, long-time lurker. I’m working through ACCA (4 papers down) and I handle the books at an IT hardware distributor here in Karachi. Mostly QuickBooks Desktop: bank recs, AP/AR, month-end, financial statements, plus some multi-currency stuff since we import from China, Taiwan and Dubai.   I’d like to start taking on a few small remote clients on the side, but I’m honestly stuck on the “how do I find them” part. I’ve emailed a few bookkeeping firms and messaged some people on LinkedIn, and so far it’s mostly silence. I know I’m competing with a lot of people, and I’m in a different country and timezone, so I get that it’s an uphill climb.   A few things I’d love to hear from people who’ve done this:     Where did your first couple of clients come from? Referrals, Upwork, local networking, something else?   Does being outside the US make clients nervous, and how do you deal with that?   Is it worth learning QuickBooks Online properly first, or just pick it up as clients need it?   Anything you wish you’d known starting out?     Not looking for handouts, just honest advice. If you know a small firm that needs overflow help, I’m happy to chat, but mostly I’d like to learn how others got started.   Thanks!       submitted by     /u/knowledgabledude       [link]       [comments]
